contracts.invariant: Eight disjoint atoms total 100; circles represent the membership mask of every displayed region.
The coefficient after j orders is the signed binomial partial sum for one object in four events.
Each stage excludes one more outside bit; the final nonnegative vector reconstructs the original inclusive table.
The known higher counts contribute binomial multiples; after five steps the counts sum to 50.
Orders one and three give upper bounds; order two gives a lower bound. The current interval never asserts an unproved attainable endpoint.
A specified omission set leaves exactly (3-|I|)^4 functions; the outputs remain labeled.
Every frame is a bijection; fixed-point status comes from its exact assignments, not from color alone.
Forced positions and labels are removed together; remaining completions count all bijections, including further fixed points.
Each selected cell is a forced assignment; repeated row or column means an empty event intersection.
Committed thresholds are 3, 4 and 5; residual stars-and-bars counts are zero for a negative budget.
The highlighted integers satisfy every selected divisor condition; the intersection denominator is the lcm.
Ten tenth-unit masses total one; union and conditional weights come from exact region masses.
Linear arrangements permit path components with at most one predecessor and successor; cycles are excluded.

limitations: Finite checks supplement general proofs; the model contracts and bounded input ranges delimit the claims.
